decisions.reason: As a newly launched bulk container with its own page that sits very close to the firm's core reusable-packaging business, management is likely to justify its investment and give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.

Although a valve is narrower and easier to prune than a full container line, it was visibly introduced on its own page and builds directly on the established offer, so escalation of commitment still makes continued support more likely than exit.

The take-back service is less prominently marketed than A or B, but it fits the firm's stated move toward service-based, sustainable reusable-packaging solutions, which makes management likely to persist with it despite any early uncertainty.
